metadata.description: Example expert-curated RCA prior. Project Zero-style RCA records can be normalized into this shape.

records.bug_class: Integer overflow leading to out-of-bounds access
records.vulnerability_details: A length calculation trusts attacker-controlled input and allocates a buffer that is too small.
records.root_cause_summary: The root cause is an unchecked size computation that later controls allocation and copy bounds.
records.patch_analysis: The fix validates the length before allocation and rejects inputs that would exceed the destination buffer.
records.exploit_flow: Malformed input influences length, length controls allocation, and a later copy writes beyond the allocation.
records.variant_analysis: Related parsers should audit size calculations that feed allocation or copy operations.
records.structural_improvements: Centralize bounds validation for length fields before allocation.
